mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.09% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following the current federal funds rate of 0.09% are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 260 signals accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following CPIAUCSL > 260.0 are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and monthly payroll growth is negative, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS (mo-mo change) < 0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing recovery phase (when housing starts and residential fixed investment are both above their 12-month moving averages), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns due to improved consumer confidence and economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 12mo_MA and RSAFS > 12mo_MA, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production reading below 95.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following INDPRO < 95.0 are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate of 10.2% signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following the current unemployment rate of 10.2% are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.1% and CPIAUCSL is above 258.0, it signals a combination of ultra-low interest rates and accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 and CPIAUCSL > 258.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (defined by industrial production below 95.0), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns due to heightened economic uncertainty and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 95.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
